run_mako_plugin: run the mako_plugin function to extract proto file names from a build dictionary
review_mako_plugin: review the mako_plugin function that parses libs and targets to find .proto files
test_mako_plugin: test the mako_plugin function with a dictionary containing libs and targets with proto sources
refactor_mako_plugin: refactor the mako_plugin to support additional file extensions beyond .proto
summarize_mako_plugin: summarize the mako_plugin function that builds a sorted list of unique proto file names
